description: Deterministic ck.morph.schema_migrate transformation vectors (zh/models/morph.md §4.1 S3 + the migration profile additional_requirements.deterministic_transformation_must). Each vector seeds a Morph from input.fields with input.from_schema_refs, POSTs a ck.morph.schema_migrate carrying input.payload, then asserts the post-migration Morph fields projection equals expected_output under Arkret canonical JSON (sorted keys, no whitespace). expected_output_digest is sha256 over those canonical bytes. The transformation_rules[] dialect ids are the canonical ck.transform.*.v1 set the profile transformation_rules_v1_grammar declares. Schema ids are the registered reference profiles ck.schema.morph.customer_risk.v1 and its additive extension ck.schema.morph.customer_risk.ext.v1.

vectors.description: A field-rename transformation: fields.risk_score is renamed to fields.score; the unrelated fields.status passes through untouched. Pure rename, replay-deterministic.

A default-backfill transformation: a new optional field fields.priority is backfilled with the deterministic default "normal" while existing fields.status is preserved. Backfill is idempotent (it never overwrites a present value).
